reason: This PR is primarily a DDL/disttask change for runtime tuning of add-index local sort. Nearly all touched files are under `pkg/ddl`, `pkg/disttask`, `pkg/meta`, `pkg/resourcemanager`, and RealTiKV tests. The only focus-module touch is `pkg/executor/operate_ddl_jobs.go`, and from the metadata that looks incidental control-path plumbing for DDL jobs rather than a change centered on executor/query semantics. No clear signal of planner, expression, session/sessionctx, statistics, kv/store, parser, table, or privilege behavior being the core of the PR.
